player_prompt.intro:
Oli Mchezaji {player_id} akicheza {colour} ({piece}) mu mupiira wa Othello.
Ggwanga lyo ni kulaba nguli nyingi za rangi yo ku board ku nkomerero ya mupiira.
Ku kyaawe, simba nguli etyakulekeza nguli za mchezaji wa pili - mu mpangilio wowote (wansi, waggulu, oba diagonal) - wakatiyo nguli yo empya n'enguli endala yo etyaliwo.  Nguli zonna za mchezaji wa pili zitakubwa ku rangi yo.
Laba mu kifoortani ya '[row, col]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Okutambula kulina okubeera mu kika kya [row, col].
invalid_move.illegal: Okutambula mu ngeri emenya amateeka. Okugenda okw'obutuufu: {valid}

game_message.must_skip: Muzannyi {pid} ({piece}) tewali malamwa malungi naye asigale.
